goal: Ship v2.4.0 human-governed decision authority without changing the protected model lanes.
deliverable: scripts/authority.py, integrations, tests, docs; candidate tag v2.4.0

ideas.summary: Enforce the boundary with a prompt paragraph and a checklist.
ideas.assessment: Prompt-only control is explicitly forbidden by the requirement; a script gate is needed.

hard.text: GPT only through scripts/run_gpt.py; DeepSeek only through the DSH host session.
Reviewers write nothing; no new dependency and no background service.
Never claim host-wide enforcement or agent-proof identity.

preferences.text: Prefer a smaller, testable change over a broad refactor.
Prefer a mature library only when it does not add a runtime dependency.
